title.value: Guidelines for the Computational Testing of Machine Learning approaches to Vehicle Routing Problems
title.justification: The title of the paper, as provided, is the main heading for the document and summarizes its primary topic and purpose.
title.quote: Guidelines for the Computational Testing of Machine Learning approaches to Vehicle Routing Problems

extractions.description: The paper discusses the challenges and guidelines for computational testing of machine learning approaches to vehicle routing problems, emphasizing the integration of methods from machine learning and operations research communities. It aims to improve the adoption of machine learning techniques in operations research by aligning the evaluation methodologies with those standard in vehicle routing problems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving computational testing of machine learning approaches for vehicle routing problems. While it has potential applications in transportation optimization relevant to sustainability, it is not directly centered on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Despite the extensive research efforts and the remarkable results obtained on Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP) by using algorithms proposed by the Machine Learning community... most of these approaches are still seldom employed by the Operations Research (OR) community.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on machine learning methodologies applied to vehicle routing problems, with no direct emphasis on climate or ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: Our aim was that of providing a set of reference guidelines that would help the machine learning community to produce computational studies that would be better appreciated by the operations research, and especially the vehicle routing, community.

primary_sub_category.justification: As no direct relevance to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories is found, the sub-category is marked as N/A.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...we want to highlight a number of challenges (and possible ways to handle them) arising during the computational studies of heuristic approaches to VRPs...

applications.justification: The discussion on vehicle routing problems implicitly relates to optimizing transportation, which can have sustainable impacts by improving efficiency and reducing emissions, though not addressed as a core theme.
applications.quote: Vehicle routing problems (VRPs) are, in fact, increasingly receiving attention in the ML community both because of their relevance in real-world applications and the computational challenges they pose.

new_primary_category.justification: The focus is not directly on creating new systems or methods for sustainable development but rather on the integration of computational testing practices.
